verdict.rationale: Mistral documents official SDK clients in both Python and TypeScript, so the core capability exists. Nothing in the pack shows those SDKs are typed or that they cover the OCR/annotation and batch job endpoints. Missing for 10: evidence of typed models, evidence of SDK coverage of OCR parse, annotations extract and batch jobs, documented sensible defaults, independent or hands-on SDK corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, official typed SDKs for Python and TypeScript cover the full API — parse, extract, jobs — with sensible defaults

citations.quote: We provide official SDK clients in both Python and Typescript
